title: Creative All Stars Academy overview
text: Creative All Stars Academy (CASA) is an inclusive education centre in Ngata, Nakuru City, Kenya. The school motto is ‘Endeavour to Succeed’. Its mission is to provide holistic development and education that enables every learner to realise their full potential. Its vision is to be an inclusive education centre that develops learners in all aspects of growth. The school follows Kenya’s competency-based education approach and supports knowledge, practical skills, values, attitudes, communication, creativity and whole-learner development.

title: Classes and learning pathway
text: The learning pathway includes Early Years (Playgroup, PP1 and PP2), Primary School (Grades 1 to 6), and Junior School. Creative All Stars Academy introduced Grade 7 in 2026. Early Years uses supportive, play-based foundations for language, numeracy, creativity, social development and independence. Primary learning uses learner-centred classroom experiences and practical application. Core learning areas described by the school include Mathematics, English and Kiswahili, Science and Technology, Social Studies, Religious Education and Creative Arts. Exact learning areas and current class arrangements vary by level and should be confirmed with the school.

title: Admissions process
text: Families can begin with an admission enquiry and arrange guidance from the admissions team. The published pathway is: send an enquiry; provide the learner’s required documents; schedule a friendly placement interaction or assessment; then, after a successful assessment, receive an official acceptance letter and follow the current fee-payment instructions to reserve a place. Documents may include a birth certificate, previous progress report and school clearance form for transfers, plus an immunisation booklet for ECDE applicants where applicable. Class availability, placement, documents, dates and payment instructions must be confirmed directly with the school. The full online admission form is available on the Admissions page.

title: Official contact, location and office hours
text: Creative All Stars Academy is located in Ngata, Nakuru City, Kenya. Official telephone: +254 724 838 674. Official email: info@creativeallstarsacademy.sc.ke. Office hours: Monday to Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:00 PM; Saturday, 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM. The Contact page contains the administrator-controlled Google Maps location and an enquiry form. Visitors can contact the school to arrange a consultation or school tour.

title: Fees, payment and transport information
text: No fixed fee amounts, payment account details or transport charges are included in the verified core knowledge. For the current fee structure, payment instructions, transport availability or route charges, contact the school on +254 724 838 674 or info@creativeallstarsacademy.sc.ke. The Parents Corner or Admissions page may show a current PDF only when an administrator has uploaded and published it. Confirm the document’s date and all payment details directly with the school before paying.

title: Co-curricular activities
text: Published co-curricular activities include guidance and counselling, swimming, journalism, games and sports, drama and music, debate, scouting, Health Club, and Modelling and Dance Club. These activities support wellbeing, creativity, teamwork, fitness, leadership, communication and confident expression. Current schedules, availability and participation arrangements are shared by the school administration each term and should be confirmed directly.

title: Verified school history
text: Creative All Stars Academy opened as a preschool in 2017 with 14 learners, three teachers and one driver. It introduced Grade 1 in 2020, expanded with upper-primary classes in 2023, presented its first KPSEA candidates in 2025, and opened Junior School with its first Grade 7 learners in 2026.

title: School uniform information
text: The school publishes separate uniform requirements for ECDE, Primary girls, Primary boys, Primary tracksuit, Junior School tracksuit, and Junior School boys and girls. The published FAQ says Creative All Stars Academy uniforms are available at Woolshop. Families should use the Parents Corner for the complete current list and confirm sizing, stock and prices with the school or supplier.
